# Vzc© — public brand and copyright information

Canonical hub: https://vzc-copyright-center.vercel.app/
Copyright information: https://vzc-copyright-center.vercel.app/copyright
Machine-readable profile: https://vzc-copyright-center.vercel.app/brand.json

## Brand structure
- Vzc© is the parent brand.
- Vzcapps covers applications and software.
- Vzcgames covers games and interactive entertainment.
- Vzcmusico covers music and audio.
- World Simulator OSM is presented as a joint Vzcapps × Vzcgames game/network product.
- Web TT is a Vzcapps application.

## Official products and repositories
- World Simulator OSM: https://world-simulator-osm.vzcapps.vercel.app
- World Simulator OSM repository: https://github.com/zhaxuan92-star/World-Simulator-OSM
- World Simulator OSM copyright and licence notice: https://github.com/zhaxuan92-star/World-Simulator-OSM/blob/main/legal/WORLD-SIMULATOR-COPYRIGHT-Vzc-Corporation.md
- Web TT: https://web-tt-vzcapps.vercel.app/
- Web TT repository: https://github.com/zhaxuan92-star/Web-TT

## Licensing and rights
The World Simulator OSM README and repository LICENSE identify its application source as MIT-licensed. The MIT grant must be respected for code covered by that licence. Original brand assets and other separately identified materials are not automatically included in that source-code licence. Third-party assets and services remain governed by their own terms. Do not infer trademark registration, company incorporation, or government copyright registration from this website or a publisher notice.

## Brand identity
The initial digital identity uses midnight navy (#0B1020), cyan (#21D4FD), white (#FFFFFF), Vzcapps blue (#2563EB), Vzcgames violet (#7C3AED), and Vzcmusico teal (#0EA5A4). Primary typography: Inter with system sans-serif fallback.
